instruction: Open the Top topics view on the FlightAware discussions forum.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated from flightaware.com to discussions.flightaware.com, searched 'community', clicked 'FlightAware Community Discord?' thread, scrolled through it for many turns but never found the topic with most replies (The Banter Thread).
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate flightaware.com, find and click footer links, reach discussions.flightaware.com, use search, click discussion topics, scroll through threads.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model searched for keyword 'community' instead of sorting/browsing topics by reply count. Picked the first search result instead of identifying the topic with the most replies.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed to navigation + tab interaction: reach discussions and click 'Top' tab. This is directly relevant to the original task since sorting by Top would have helped find the most-replied topic. Model saw but never used these tabs.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to FlightAware discussions and opening the Top tab. Evaluator checks that active URL matches discussions.flightaware.com/top using regex pattern matching. This sub-task directly addresses the skill gap that caused the original failure.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to check for a navigation task.
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly receives the rules dict via type='rule' and accesses rules['expected'] to get the regex patterns. Parameter handling is correct.
Expected URL pattern 'https://discussions\.flightaware\.com/top' correctly matches the Discourse Top topics view URL on FlightAware discussions forum.
Single instruction requirement (navigate to Top topics view) is fully covered by the single URL pattern check. Complete coverage.
Data flow is correct: getter returns URL string -> metric regex-matches against expected pattern -> returns 1.0 on match or 0.0 on mismatch.
